The '''1931-32 Serie A''' was the thirty-second edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and the third since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the ninth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Juventus]] were champions for the second of five successive seasons and for the fourth time in their [[history]]. This was their third scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their second win contested as Serie A.
[[Image:Serie A (football) 1931-32.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1930-31 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] and [[AS Bari|Bari]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
